notes.title: Ball 2D will be a free to play!
notes.notes:
Since 30.01.2018, Ball 2D: Soccer Online will be available for free!

I think it will be more fair to make the game free. More players will be able to enjoy the game. I would also like to say thank you to those who bought the game, your support is very important to me and thanks to it I can keep making games.
